fullTextEN: Hello! Welcome to Lazy Chinese.
I am Xika.
I am Taiwanese.
How are you?

fullTextZH: 今天我们聊聊台湾的房子。
fullTextEN: Today we talk about houses in Taiwan.
If you ask Taiwanese people,
Are houses in Taiwan expensive?

fullTextZH: 很多台湾人会告诉你：贵！
fullTextEN: Many Taiwanese will tell you: expensive!
Very expensive.

fullTextZH: 因为薪水，就是工作赚的钱，
fullTextEN: Because salaries, which is the money earned from work,
are very low, not much.
But houses are very expensive.
Houses are very expensive.
I also don't have a house.

fullTextZH: 现在你知道台湾的房子很贵。
fullTextEN: Now you know houses in Taiwan are very expensive.

fullTextZH: 那有没有便宜的房子呢？
fullTextEN: So are there any cheap houses?
Yes, there is a type of cheap house.
Guess,

fullTextZH: 怎么样的房子很便宜呢？
fullTextEN: What kind of house is very cheap?
Is it an ugly house?
Is it a very far house?
Is it a very noisy house?

fullTextZH: 对，有这些问题的房子比较便宜。
fullTextEN: Yes, houses with these problems are relatively cheap.

fullTextZH: 但是还有一种房子在台湾也比较便宜，
fullTextEN: But there is another type of house that is also relatively cheap in Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 就是以前有死人的房子。
fullTextEN: which are houses where people have died before.

fullTextZH: 你想，有死人的房子很多，
fullTextEN: You think, there are many houses where people have died,
right?

fullTextZH: 不是全部有死人的房子都便宜。
fullTextEN: Not all houses where people have died are cheap.

fullTextZH: 如果有人因为老了、生病，
fullTextEN: If someone died because of old age or illness,
and died in the house,
then it doesn't matter.

fullTextZH: 但是，如果有人因为不好的事，
fullTextEN: But, if someone died because of something bad,

fullTextZH: 比如自杀、自己杀死自己，
fullTextEN: like suicide, killing oneself,
or murder,
someone killing someone else,
someone died because of something bad,
and died in the house,
we call this type of house a 'haunted house'.
Haunted houses, maybe British people,

fullTextZH: 美国人、法国人都不喜欢。
fullTextEN: Americans, French people all don't like.

fullTextZH: 可是台湾人特别不喜欢，
fullTextEN: But Taiwanese people really don't like it,
Especially afraid.

fullTextZH: 所以这种房子比较便宜。
fullTextEN: So this kind of house is relatively cheap.
For example, there is a house,
The previous price was 10 million yuan.

fullTextZH: 如果有人在房子里死了，
fullTextEN: If someone died in the house,
Because of something bad, they died,

fullTextZH: 那价格可能会变成500万元。
fullTextEN: Then the price might become 5 million yuan.
Let me tell you a true story.
In Taiwan, there was a man,
He bought a house.
After he bought the house,
He was very happy.

fullTextZH: 可是他的邻居告诉他：呃...
fullTextEN: But his neighbor told him: uh...
The house you bought has a bit of a problem.
The man asked what problem?
The neighbor told him,
Your house had a dead person before,
Because of something bad, they died.
The man was very angry when he heard this,
Because he didn't know about this matter.

fullTextZH: 他不知道以前房子里有死人，
fullTextEN: He didn't know there were dead people in the house before,

fullTextZH: 因为卖房子的人没有告诉他。
fullTextEN: because the person selling the house didn't tell him.
The man spent 9 million yuan to buy the house,
but this house is a haunted house,
it should be cheaper.
So he is very angry.
If it were you,
what would you do?
In Taiwan,

fullTextZH: 卖房子的人没有告诉买房子的人，
fullTextEN: the person selling the house didn't tell the person buying the house,
this house is a haunted house,
this is not allowed.

fullTextZH: 卖房子的人必须告诉买房子的人，
fullTextEN: The person selling the house must tell the person buying the house,
this house is a haunted house,
there were dead people before.
Like this man,
when he bought the house,
he didn't know the house was a haunted house.
He is very angry,

fullTextZH: 所以他去告卖房子的人。
fullTextEN: So he went to sue the person selling the house.

fullTextZH: 就是他去法院说：卖房子的人不好！
fullTextEN: He went to court and said: The person selling the house is bad!

fullTextZH: 最后卖房子的人要坐牢，
fullTextEN: In the end, the person selling the house had to go to jail,

fullTextZH: 因为他没说他的房子是凶宅。
fullTextEN: because he didn't say his house was haunted.
This is not allowed in Taiwan.
My foreign friends,
when they heard this story,
all said: I'm not afraid of ghosts,

fullTextZH: 快！我要去台湾买这种房子！
fullTextEN: Quick! I want to go to Taiwan to buy this kind of house!
What about you? Are you too?
In your country,
houses where people died before,
is everyone afraid or not?
Please leave a message and tell me!
See you next time, byebye!
